translation.name: Yuusa chichame yaunchukia tura yamaram chichamjai aarmau

content: Jesucristo shuarnum akina asa jui pujus waittsauwaiti. Tuma asamtai atumsha waitmainaitrume. Shuar Jesucriston umiruk waitaka, tunaun inaisauwaiti.
Jesucristo wakeramun umiktasa waitaka, ni wakeramu takatnaka inaimainaiti.

Yaunchukka atumka shuar Yuusan nekainatsu nujai metek pujuina asarum, tunau takata nuke wakerusrum takákrum, atumi nuwenchu taká jakuitrume, tura nampe jakuitrume, tura nampekrum chichakmaikia yutaisha yu jakuitrume. Tumakrum ina Yuusri nakitamua nu, yuusrimattsa najanamusha emematu jakuitrume.
Nui shuar atumjai iruuntrar tunaun taká jaku ainaka atum yamai tunau takat nakitamun waitmainak, ¿urukakug yamaisha aniawa? tusar atumin pachitmasar pegkerchau chichainawai.
Turasha Jesucristo winak, shuar iwáku ainan jakau ainajai, nita takasmaurin iiras waittan susatnaiti.

Tuma asamtai shuar ainaka waittan juinak, nita iyashiinka jau ainawai. Tura Yuusan nekaspapita tinu ainasha tumasag jakaru ainawai. Turasha Yuusan nekaspapita tu ajakaru ainaka, Cristo uwemtikartina nu nekaspapita tamaunum wakanka Yuusjai metek tuke pujusartinaiti tamaun antukaru ainawai.
Jesucristonam surumankau aina yainaimain pachisa timau
Nugka mesera nagkankatnuka tsawan ashi jeawai. Tuma asamtai atumka aneaku pujakrum, Yuus seataarma.
Ashi juna nagkasauwa nu atum ainatirmeka anenaitarma, tumakrum pegkerchau aina nuka takasairpa.
Atumin jeemincha irainak winitramainaka, ishishmasam pegkerchau chichartsuk, shir anenaisrum junaitarma.
Yuus chiki chikichik atum takamainan suramsauwaiti. Turamu asarum atumka chikichjaisha yainaiktarma.

Tura Yuusa chichame etserkurmesha, nina chichamen aarmauwa nuka metek etserkatarma. Tura chikich aina yayákrumsha, Yuus nina senchirin ama nujai ashi imatiksarmek yaigtarma. Nu turakrum Jesucriston akupturmaku asamtai, Yuus ememattarma. Jesucristoka arumaisha tuke ememattai, ima nigki anturtai tuke atinaiti. Nunis atii.
Waitakrisha shir anemainaitji timau
Aneetair yatsur, umaar ainata, atumin nekapramainak senchi waitkarmasartin ainawai. Imatikramainakaisha ¿uruka ima waitaja? tusarmeka enentaima pujuirpa.
Atumsha Jesucristo waittsamua nu tumasrumek waitaina asarum, ni tsaaptin jas winakaisha, atum ima shir aneasrum nakunkut pujustin asarum, shir aneastarma.
Tura atum Cristo nemarin asaakrumin, pegkerchau chichartamainakaisha, Wakan Pegker nekas senchirtina nu atumin pujau asamtai, shir aneasrum pujustarma.
Atum ainarum nuiya magkartichu ainayat, kasamchau ainayat, tunau takachu ainayat, chikichan pachis pegkerchaun chicharchau ainayat waitainawai.
Turasha atumka Cristonu asarum, waitakrumsha natsaamtsuk shir aneasrum Yuus ememattarma.
Yuus nekaspapita tinu ainati waittsatin tsawan yamaika jeayi. Tuma asamtai, shuar Yuusa chichamen umikcharu ainaka waitat shir ashammainan jukiartin ainawai.
Shuar uwemraru ainasha ju nugka jui pujusarka senchi waittsatin ainawai. Tura shuar tunau aina nuka nu senchi waittsartin ainawai.
Tura Yuus atumin waittsati tusa wakerutmakaigka, waitakrumsha pegkera nuke tuke takatarma. Tura nigka pegke inaitamsashtin asamtai, Yuus atumin najatmawa nuke enentaimtitarma.
